parsed.name: 串口CAN总线通信组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过串口设备进行基础 CAN 总线消息收发与连接管理，常用于实验系统中连接、转发或管理基于 CAN 的仪器通信。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component for basic CAN bus messaging and connection management over a serial device, typically used in laboratory systems to connect, relay, or manage communication with CAN-based instruments.

actions.description: 通过串口链路发送一条 CAN 消息。
actions.description_en: Send a CAN message over the serial link.

actions.description: 返回底层串口接口的文件描述符。
actions.description_en: Return the file descriptor of the underlying serial interface.
